speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I see you've been feeling very tired and have had some fever and bruising for the past three weeks. Can you tell me if the leg pain is constant or if it comes and goes, and have you noticed any bleeding from your gums or nose?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has she noticed any swollen lymph nodes in her neck, armpits, or groin, or any abdominal swelling? I would also like to examine her for any petechiae or palpable masses.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
I suspect acute leukemia given the triad of bone pain, fever, and signs of bone marrow failure, so I need to check her white cell count, hemoglobin, and platelets immediately.

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal peripheral smear is unexpected given the severe symptoms, so I must rule out other causes of bone pain and fever. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy
